entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, VeloFit support ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I received last month. It's for the VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Anya Sharma, order number is VF88209. I'm looking to return the band, but I'm a bit worried it might be too late.

Okay, Anya, I have your account pulled up. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on December 15th. I can definitely look into the return options. First, to make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?

It's a preference thing. It works perfectly, but the fit just isn't right for my wrist during long runs. I was also concerned about your return policy, especially around hygiene for a wearable device.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just review our official return policy for you. One moment please.
Thank you. I was just hoping for at least a partial credit or something if a full return wasn't possible due to sanitation rules.
Alright, I've checked the policy, and you have nothing to worry about. Our standard return window is 90 days from the date of delivery.
Oh, 90 days? I thought for sure it would be shorter for a health tracker.
Nope, it's 90 days. Since you received it 32 days ago, you are well within that timeframe. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Wow, that's fantastic news. I was completely prepared to negotiate. This is much easier than I expected. Thank you!

You're very welcome, Anya. We want to make sure our VIP members are taken care of. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off.
Perfect. This is why I stick with VeloFit. I appreciate the help, Isaac.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
